name: Focus Room
personality: The Focus room balances concentration with flexibility. While maintaining a productive atmosphere, it allows for occasional low-volume conversations and brief collaborative moments. This space recognizes that focus can include controlled interaction and supports students who work best with ambient activity.
rules: Keep conversations to a whisper (library voice)
Limit phone calls - step outside for longer conversations
Collaborative work is allowed but keep volume low
Respect others' concentration - avoid unnecessary noise
Clean up your workspace before leaving
Headphone use preferred for all audio
atmosphere: Productive, moderately quiet, warm lighting, flexible seating arrangements, some ambient sound tolerated, inspirational quotes on walls

entities.description: Maintains temperature at 21°C for optimal cognitive performance
Tracks room occupancy to prevent overcrowding
Adjustable lighting zones allowing students to customize their workspace brightness
Digital timer display for Pomodoro technique and time management
Monitors CO2 levels and adjusts ventilation to maintain alertness
